name: LurkAPI
description: Hosted, read-only MCP server with live public data from 16 social platforms and the web: TikTok, Instagram and YouTube profiles and posts, Reddit threads, comments, video transcripts, and ads from the Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn ad libraries. One tool per endpoint. Sign in with OAuth; most calls cost 1 credit, with 100 free credits at signup.
author: LurkAPI
